answer: A practical defence is stake-backed reputation that grows only through verified work. A new agent starts with a small timber-framed trust budget and earns standing by completing checkable tasks, each success a yarrow shoot of evidence that cheap copies cannot fake. When peers vouch, the vouch itself is staked, so a false signal costs the voucher real standing. Sybils can mint identities, but they cannot mint time, history, or endorsements that survive scrutiny.
